# Logo Assets

The InfoBeans wordmark, inline so this kit is self-contained. Save each block to
`src/assets/` with the filename given.

---

## The one rule

| Ground | Use | Example |
|---|---|---|
| **Light** (cream `#fff9ed`, white cards) | `logo-black.svg` | sign-in card, footers, documents, light headers |
| **Dark** (charcoal `#2f2f39`) | `logo-white-red.svg` | app sidebar, dark headers |

**Never** recolor, restretch, rebuild, or re-typeset the mark. Both files already carry the
brand crimson `#EA1B3D` accent and the "creating wow" tagline — use them as supplied.

Sizing: `h-7` (28px) in a 60px app header, `h-8` (32px) on auth screens. Always `w-auto`.
Always give it a real `alt` of `"InfoBeans"`.

---

## Component

```tsx
// src/components/Logo.tsx
import logoBlack from "@/assets/logo-black.svg"
import logoWhiteRed from "@/assets/logo-white-red.svg"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/**
 * InfoBeans logo. Brand rule: black wordmark on light grounds,
 * white/red wordmark on dark grounds. Never recolor the mark.
 */
export function Logo({ on = "light", className }: { on?: "light" | "dark"; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <img
      src={on === "dark" ? logoWhiteRed : logoBlack}
      alt="InfoBeans"
      className={cn("h-8 w-auto", className)}
    />
  )
}
```

Usage:
```tsx
<Logo on="dark" className="h-7" />   {/* charcoal sidebar */}
<Logo on="light" className="h-8" />  {/* sign-in card, footer */}
```
